output_list.reason: The 'buyFromRC' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not ensure that 'remainingTokens' is always greater than or equal to 'tokenAmount' before the transfer operation, allowing attackers to exploit this vulnerability to overflow the 'remainingTokens' variable and achieve arbitrary token distribution.
The 'claim' function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It allows only restricted addresses to mint tokens, which can be exploited by attackers to mint tokens to any address.
